title: Tour: Opportunities & Pipelines
blurb: Set up your sales pipelines and how deals are tracked.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Opportunities & Pipelines
steps.body: Click **Opportunities & Pipelines** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Your pipelines
steps.body: A pipeline is the set of steps a job or sale moves through, like New Lead, Quoted, Booked, Won. Your pipelines are listed here.

steps.title: Stages
steps.body: Open a pipeline to add, rename, reorder or remove its stages.

steps.title: Reporting
steps.body: Each stage can be shown or hidden in the dashboard funnel and pie charts.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Create a sales pipeline** from the Guide.
